verified.note: Agenzia delle Entrate's own scheda for the eleven-digit codice fiscale, which publishes its structure: seven progressive digits, three office digits and a final “carattere di controllo” computed over the first ten. That is the same construction as the partita IVA check, which is why both eleven-digit forms take the same engine. The sixteen-character personal code's control letter is defined by D.M. 23 dicembre 1976 and is not on this page.

note.en: The eleventh digit is a Luhn check over the ten before it.

A person's codice fiscale is sixteen characters closed by the CIN check letter; omocodia substitutions, where a digit is replaced by a letter to separate two people who would otherwise collide, are accepted and take part in the check as written. An entity's is eleven digits and is the same number as its Partita IVA, so it takes the same Luhn.
Electronic address for e-invoice routing: the EAS scheme code plus your identifier. Carry it now and the card is already correct when a counterparty moves to Peppol.
note.es: Dirección electrónica para el enrutamiento de facturas: el código de esquema EAS más tu identificador. Tenerlo ya deja la tarjeta lista cuando una contraparte pase a Peppol.

codiceDestinatario.display: M5UXCR1 · 0000000 if you have none · XXXXXXX for a foreign supplier

note.en: Give the Codice Destinatario or PEC address as well as the tax number — the invoice routes on it. Both have their own field on this card.
